tactics.name: Exact search intent
tactics.deliverable: Stable H1 for world clock and every city; time immediately visible
tactics.measurement: GSC search query and landing page impressions
tactics.next: Observe actual queries, then experiment with copy

tactics.name: Earn genuine backlinks
tactics.deliverable: Research relevant publishers; never auto-send outreach
tactics.measurement: Qualifying referring websites and referral visits
tactics.next: Shortlist educational, travel and global-team resources for owner review

tactics.name: Make a shareable utility
tactics.deliverable: Share or copy selected city clock with no GPS coordinates
tactics.next: Validate share flow on mobile; consider a small embeddable clock only after demand

tactics.name: Unique city page value
tactics.deliverable: Eight useful pre-rendered city pages and two seasonal guides
tactics.measurement: Indexed pages, query impressions and meaningful clicks
tactics.next: Only expand pages after Search Console confirms demand

tactics.name: Real localization
tactics.deliverable: Dutch Belgian guides; avoid bogus hreflang between unrelated pages
tactics.next: Consider reviewed French/German equivalents once demand appears

tactics.name: Speed and Core Web Vitals
tactics.deliverable: Build gzip budget + existing clock optimization + optional Lighthouse evidence
tactics.measurement: Actual mobile LCP/INP/CLS; compressed JS/CSS bytes
tactics.next: Measure mobile CWV; do not call bundle gzip a Lighthouse score

tactics.name: Search result clarity
tactics.deliverable: Stable titles, descriptions, canonicals, WebSite and per-city WebPage, favicon
tactics.measurement: GSC per-query CTR at a comparable rank
tactics.next: Verify Google's real snippets before changing titles

tactics.name: Internal navigation
tactics.deliverable: Related city comparison links, seasonal guides and UnixTime contextual link
tactics.next: Add cross-repo links only when relevant and owner-approved

tactics.name: Accuracy and trust
tactics.deliverable: IANA zones, server calibration status, boundary approximation disclosure and credits
tactics.measurement: Time accuracy regressions and quality mentions
tactics.next: Document source versions and official rule changes

tactics.name: Evidence-driven optimization
tactics.deliverable: Windsor/Search Console evidence and machine-readable proposals with approval gates
tactics.measurement: Impressions, clicks, indexed URLs and experiments
tactics.next: Start no scheduled monitor without explicit owner approval
